lines.text: A buzzing sound tears through the air...
Red light gathers above the statue.
The Queen has already finished all her calculations and deductions.
Presently, Ark No. 1 has no way to defend against Weapon 01.
The Enemy of the Same Nature has been neutralized,
and there are no Nikkes Specializing in Defense in the line of fire.
All other entities capable of introducing variables have been neutralized with Weapon 05.
There are no errors in her coordinates.
If she fires Weapon 01, there's a 97.24% chance that the Ark will be destroyed.
The Queen enacts the final stage of the firing sequence for Weapon 01.
Just then, the Queen's sensors pick up something unexpected.
She detects a high-priority target for removal within firing range.
This entity used the Lift to single-handedly infiltrate her base
and dealt significant damage to Body v.03.
She compares the specs to her current Body v.05.
The results show overwhelming victory for Body v.05.
However, considering the significant amount of time that has passed, she estimates the entity's current specs.
She is a higher priority target for removal than the Ark No. 1.
The Goddess of Victory statue changes direction.
Weapon 01 changes targets toward the top-priority target for removal.
She begins the firing sequence for Weapon 01.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Everyone! Get out of the way!
Cinderella shoots up into the air.
Hansel, Gretel, Little Mermaid, and Grave split.
Floating in the air, Cinderella studies the statue.
She activates Glass Slippers, pointing the glittering surface at the statue.
Countless pale blue lights fly toward the Queen.
More and more pour out. The slender lights join until they form one mass.
The area around her is dyed pale blue.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I think she's amazing.
The world grows red, starting from the statue.
The eerie red light reaches for Cinderella.
The scene before her disappears and is replaced by red light.
Cinderella absorbs all the light from Glass Slippers.
She gnaws at her lip, feeling defeat.
She points all her Glass Slippers forward.
Little Mermaid's bubble floats in front of her, blocking the way.
Her vision is consumed by red. She can't see Cinderella.
The light stops. Far away, there's an ear-splitting explosion and vibration.
on Glass Slippers, destroyed, and Cinderella, cracks all over her body.
She knows because of Plot Spoiler. She's too late.
With a boom, Cinderella and Glass Slippers crash into the ground.
Hansel and Gretel lift Witches Cauldron.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Time for a volley of high-thermal explosions, Gretel.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Yes. We'll give it everything we've got, Hansel.
A barrage of optical rounds bursts out.
They fly in an arc, but before they can hit the statue...
... a flurry of red beams shoot from the statue.
After intercepting Hansel and Gretel's optical rounds,
Little Mermaid creates a bubble to cover Cinderella.
Hundreds of beams concentrate on one spot, cutting through the protective bubble.
There's another barrage of enormous optical rounds,
but they can't get past the red beams that fill the air.
The bubble that's acting as a shield reaches its limit.
The liquid metal making up the bubble reaches its limit.
Little Mermaid looks back at Grave.
She looks desperate, like she's about to cry.
She looks like she knows what will happen next, even without Plot Spoiler.
Grave picks up the collapsed Cinderella.
squeezing her tight, as though nothing could tear her away.
Particles burst from Grave's back again.
They spread wider and more thickly.
Their target is clear. They aim only for Cinderella.
She runs, dodging all the red beams.
Hundreds more lasers arc after the Nikke slumped in Grave's arms.
Smoke pours from her head and eyes.
but her mind, connected to her Harmony Cube, doesn't stop.
She looks further into the future.
Her brain is on overdrive. It feels like her head is going to burn up.
If she can just go a little farther, she'll be out of range of the lasers.
Little Mermaid's bubble blocks the lasers, but it's not enough.
Hansel and Gretel keep launching attacks at the statue.
She falls to the ground shielding Cinderella.
A strange-colored liquid pours from her eyes, nose, mouth, and ears.
Grave looks at Cinderella with her flowing eyes.
Red lasers carve into her back.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: with you... with all of you...
The liquid flowing from Grave's face drips onto the cracks.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I can't let you get dirty.
Cinderella manages to open her eyes.
Cinderella looks Grave in the eyes.
Reflected in her eyes, she sees the most beautiful sight in the world.
Cinderella quickly rises into the air.
All the beams change direction to aim at her.
Cinderella moves quickly through the air, cutting between the lasers.
Far away, she can see the place where the statue's head should be growing red.
Floating in the air, Cinderella looks at her friends',
They're all looking into her eyes.
As they do, they grow certain.
The broken Glass Slippers rises and moves in front of Cinderella.
It aims for the Goddess of Victory statue.
Red light bursts from the statue.
Glass Slippers emits a pale blue light.
Cinderella is swallowed up by the red light.
Glass Slippers disappears without a trace.
Cinderella turns her eyes to meet the gazes of her family.
she sees the most beautiful sight in the world.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: As long as you're all looking at me,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: As long as you're all looking at me,
Black light bursts from Cinderella's body.
Her pale blue light, which absorbs the eerie red light, is in full bloom.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... I knew it would go this way.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I didn't expect to use this so soon, though.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I am beautiful because I have you.
The Goddess of Victory statue grows red again.
There's a collision of red light and pale blue.
The ground around her burns and splits.
The color of the sky keeps changing. It rapidly switches between red and pale blue.
Their closely-matched battle of strength continues.
She uses all her strength to push her opponent back a little,
only to get pushed back herself.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I leave the rest to you.
The arc of the pale blue light changes.
It rushes forward, attacking the statue's body.
At the same time, red light fills Glass Carriage.
Fragments fall from it, and smoke erupts.
Nearly half of its upper body has been destroyed.
The Queen hastily regenerates the statue.
Witches Cauldron launches enormous optical rounds.
They arc toward the statue and hit their mark.
She used too much energy in the battle with Cinderella.
Still, recovery is her top priority right now.
Fragments continue dropping from the statue.
In order to conserve energy, she switches to Weapon 05.
Hundreds of red lasers aim for the attacking targets.
Little Mermaid raises what little bubbles she has left and races toward Hansel and Gretel who keep firing.
Hansel and Gretel pull Little Mermaid to them and turn over.
Hansel and Gretel are on top of Little Mermaid, covering her.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: This time, we're going to protect you.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Yes. We're going to protect you.
Little Mermaid stares at the incoming red beams
There's a red explosion, and their shooting stops.
The Queen realizes a serious issue has occurred in the execution of her action.
Her output has decreased dramatically, and countless sensors have been ruined.
The Queen drastically adjusts the order of her action priority.
She halts all actions and focuses on regeneration.
She contemplates, using all the battle data she's acquired so far.
There is presently nothing that can put Body v.05 at risk.
The Queen starts focusing all her resources on regeneration.
That optical weapon must've fired hundreds or even thousands of rounds.
They must've arced precisely to hit their pinpoint targets.
But for some reason, all is quiet.
The Goddess of Victory statue is in ruins.
Nearly half of its upper body is gone.
There are scars from explosions all over its body.
It's not moving. To be precise, it's moving very slightly.
I don't know what's going on, but the statue has suffered great damage,
and it's clearly pouring all its resources into recovering.
The only sound is the ringing in my ears.
I'm on the deck of the Wings of Victory.
The statue is still focused on regenerating.
Just then, a missile goes flying, streaming smoke.
It hits the statue, causing an explosion.
My hearing returns, triggered by the sound of the explosion.
Countless missiles fly toward the statue.
My ears are full of the noise.
A large number of mass-produced Nikkes are attacking the statue.

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: Good. It appears the comms are up and running.

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: Sorry we're late. With an army this big, there was a lot to get ready.

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: ... are joining the fight against the Queen.
